setup.title: Claim your bot.Box server
setup.lead: Enter the bootstrap secret from your server startup output, create the first owner account, and launch your initial workspace.
setup.step1Desc: Paste the one-time secret logged on stdout when the API booted.
setup.step2Desc: Configure the administrator credentials that own this deployment.
setup.step3Desc: Name your team hub and select the sandbox runtime driver.
setup.terminalHint: Printed once on startup when no workspace exists yet.
setup.terminalLine2: WARN first-run setup required — copy your setup secret below:
setup.secretHelper: Copy the exact BOTBOX_SETUP_SECRET value shown in the server terminal or container logs.
setup.workspaceSlugHelper: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens used in workspace routes.
setup.driverDockerDesc: Single-host Linux desktop containers over local Docker socket.
setup.driverK8sDesc: Cluster-scheduled pods with isolated egress network policies.

auth.title: Sign in to bot.Box
auth.lead: Access your team workspaces, sandboxed bot computers, and member controls.
